facts.fact: Yes, Aadhaar seeding is mandatory for PM-KISAN payments (from the 3rd instalment onwards)
facts.quote: Aadhaar seeding of beneficiaries' data was made mandatory for release of 3'o installment pertaining to the period 01.08.2019, and for subsequent installments onwards.

facts.fact: Aadhaar was optional only for the 1st instalment (period 1.12.2018 to 31.3.2019)
facts.quote: Aadhaar number was optional and not mandatory for release of 1st installment pertaining to the period 01 .12.2018 to 31.03.2019

facts.fact: The exemption for Assam, Meghalaya and J&K ran only till 31 March 2020, so it is not current
facts.quote: and therefore these States have been exempted from the requirement till 31't N/arch, 2020.

facts.fact: eKYC is also mandatory for registered PM-KISAN farmers
facts.quote: eKYC is MANDATORY for PMKISAN Registered Farmers.

summary: Revised FAQ: Aadhaar optional only for the 1st instalment, mandatory from the 3rd; NE/J&K exemption till 31.3.2020; portal says eKYC is mandatory.
